teaser.en: A climbing bean that covers fences in purple flowers, then feeds the household with its pods, seeds and leaves.
teaser.sw: Mharagwe unaotambaa ambao hufunika ua kwa maua ya zambarau, kisha hulisha familia kwa maganda, mbegu na majani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa kunde unaokpwera, unaofwinika chigo kpwa maruwa ga zambarau, chisha unarisa atu a nyumba kpwa makakayage, tembeze na makodzage.

summary.en: *Mpupu* is the lablab or hyacinth bean, a vigorous climber with purple flowers and flat pods. Its seeds, pods and leaves are all cooked and eaten.
summary.sw: *Mpupu* ni fiwi, mmea unaotambaa kwa nguvu wenye maua ya zambarau na maganda bapa. Mbegu, maganda na majani yake yote hupikwa na kuliwa.
summary.dg: *Mpupu* ni *lablab bean* au *hyacinth bean*, mmea unaokpwera wenye nguvu, wenye maruwa ga zambarau na makakaya mabapa. Tembeze, makakayage na makodzage vyosi nkujitwa na nkuriwa.

about.en:
*Mpupu* is a vigorous, twining bean that can cover a fence or a small tree in a season. Its leaves have three broad leaflets, and its flowers, usually purple or pinkish-purple, grow on long upright stalks above the leaves.

The pods are flat and broad, often with a purple edge, and hold several rounded seeds, each with a pale, raised scar along one side.
about.sw:
*Mpupu* ni mmea wa jamii ya maharagwe unaojizungusha na kukua kwa nguvu, unaoweza kufunika ua au mti mdogo katika msimu mmoja. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, na maua yake, kwa kawaida ya zambarau au zambarau-waridi, huota juu ya vikonyo virefu vilivyosimama juu ya majani.

Maganda ni bapa na mapana, mara nyingi yakiwa na ukingo wa zambarau, na hubeba mbegu kadhaa za mviringo, kila moja ikiwa na kovu jeupe lililoinuka upande mmoja.
about.dg:
*Mpupu* ni mmea wa kunde wenye nguvu, unaodzizunguluka, ambao unaweza kufwinika lichigo au muhi mdide kpwa msimu mmwenga. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, ni mapana, na maruwage, mara nyinji ga zambarau au ga zambarau-kundu, ganamera kpwa milita mire inayoima chocho dzulu ya makodza.

Makakaya ni mabapa na mapana, mara nyinji genye mphaka wa zambarau, na ganakala na tembe kadhaa za duara, na chila tembe ina alama ya rangi ya kufifia iriyoinuka uphande mmwenga.

where.en: *Mpupu* is grown on farms and trained over fences and around homesteads, where it can climb freely. It is easiest to spot when the purple flower spikes are out.
where.sw: *Mpupu* hupandwa mashambani na huelekezwa kutambaa juu ya nyua na kuzunguka makazi, ambapo unaweza kupanda bila kizuizi. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona wakati vishada vya maua ya zambarau vimechanua.
where.dg: *Mpupu* nkurimwa mindani na nkukpwezwa dzulu ya chigo na kanda-kanda ya midzi, ambako unaweza kukpwera bila chizuwizi. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona wakati maruwage ga zambarau ganatuluka kpwenye milita.

uses.en: The seeds and young pods are cooked, and the leaves are eaten as a vegetable. As with other legumes, the plant also enriches the soil it grows in.
uses.sw: Mbegu na maganda machanga hupikwa, na majani huliwa kama mboga. Kama mimea mingine ya jamii ya kunde, mmea huu pia huongeza rutuba ya udongo unamoota.
uses.dg: Tembe na makakaya matsanga nkujitwa, na makodza nkuriwa dza mtsunga. Dza mimea yanjina ya jamii ya kunde, mmea hinyu piya unahenda ulongo unaomera ukale mnono.

names.en: Digo: *mpupu*. The Mgombato dictionary gives its Swahili equivalent as *mfiwi mafuta*. Swahili: *fiwi*. English: lablab bean or hyacinth bean. Scientists call it *Lablab purpureus* (formerly *Dolichos lablab*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mpupu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa kisawe chake cha Kiswahili kuwa *mfiwi mafuta*. Kiswahili: *fiwi*. Kiingereza: *lablab bean* au *hyacinth bean*. Wanasayansi huuita *Lablab purpureus* (zamani *Dolichos lablab*).
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mpupu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inalavya dzina ra Chiswahili *mfiwi mafuta*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *fiwi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lablab bean* au *hyacinth bean*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Lablab purpureus* (kare *Dolichos lablab*).

reason.en: Cowpea, another bean whose leaves are eaten
reason.sw: Kunde, mharagwe mwingine ambao majani yake huliwa

reason.en: Pigeon pea, a fellow farm legume
reason.sw: Mbaazi, mmea mwenzake wa jamii ya kunde wa shambani
reason.dg: *Mbalazi*, mmea myawe wa jamii ya kunde wa mindani

reason.en: Velvet bean, a wild climbing relative
reason.sw: Upupu, jamaa yake wa porini anayetambaa
Pojo (choroko), nafaka nyingine ya jamii ya kunde ya pwani
reason.dg: *Podzo*, zao ranjina ra jamii ya kunde ra pwani
